arxiv:2609.37402.title: Routing Should Pay for Itself: Sparse Supervision for Economical LLM Routing

arxiv:2609.37559.title: APM-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-session Persistent Memory for Egocentric Streaming Video Assistants

arxiv:2609.39982.title: Mid-Harness: Scaling Actions Between Model and Harness for Terminal Agents

arxiv:2609.40340.title: EvoDuet: Bilevel Co-Evolution of Web Searching and Task Solving for Scientific Discovery

arxiv:2610.01415.title: Beyond Memory: Harnessing Long-Horizon Agents with Explicit Belief States
